card.text: When Horatio enters, exile up to three cards from your graveyard. [+1]: You may copy a card with mana value 2 or less exiled with Horatio. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.) [-3]: Copy a card with mana value 3 or {4} exiled with Horatio. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. [-7]: Copy each card exiled with Horatio. You may cast the copies without paying their mana costs.
